title: The MacBook Pro Max Just Dropped to Its Lowest Price Ever
summary: Apple will reportedly launch an innovative new MacBook next week, which means existing options have their largest discount yet.
llm_summary: Apple is set to unveil a brand‑new MacBook next week, prompting retailers to slash prices on the current MacBook Pro Max to its lowest point yet. This steep discount makes the existing high‑end model more affordable for anyone looking for top‑tier performance before the next generation arrives.
